verdict.rationale: Reducto is API-first. Its docs cover a public REST API with Parse, Extract, Split, Classify and Edit endpoints, plus async endpoints such as POST /parse_async that return job IDs, webhooks, and Python/Node.js/Go/cURL quickstart code. A probe independently confirmed a live OpenAPI spec at docs.reducto.ai/openapi.json and an llms.txt index. Missing for 10: independent hands-on reports of actually driving the API (the community items do not describe API usage, beyond one user saying they were considering it).
